title: Redirect rule item (erMatchRule)
$comment: The DynamoDB item shape the Lambda@Edge reads for a redirect (viewer-request). Modeled on EdgeRedirectRule/MatchCondition from the source project's redirect-rule-types.ts.

pk.description: Host, e.g. www.example.com. DynamoDB partition key.

sk.description: REDIRECT#<priority>, priority zero-padded to 5 digits; lower = higher priority; unique per host per type.

disabled.$comment: Optional; absent means enabled. The Lambda@Edge filters out rules where disabled=true (RulesService.loadRules), so a toggle takes effect within the edge cache TTL (~1 min). The console writes it through PATCH.

match.$comment: Shared match condition, referenced by rewrite-rule.schema.json. Field names/enums mirror MatchCondition + MatchType/MatchOperator in redirect-rule-types.ts.

headerName.description: Required when matchType is "header"; disallowed otherwise.
